balls.text: Bravo finds the boundary, bowled on a length on the off, made some room and dragged it between long-on and deep midwicket
yorker length on the off, dug out towards point for a single
low full toss and that's driven towards long-on for a single
on target on middle, makes room and drives that towards deep extra cover for a couple more
all wrist there, on middle and he lifts it into that gap between long-on and deep midwicket, Binny runs to his left and keeps them to a couple
bowled it full on middle, drives it down to long-on for a single
slower one, cuts away after landing on a good length, Bravo plays inside the line to that
four, nicely done by Bravo, three shots that didn't involve much power, short outside off, third man was inside the circle and he slashed it between point and short third man
slower one bowled short outside off, tries to cut it away, misses
couple of important boundaries these, full outside off, square drives it well through point for four
nicely done, aiming for the yorker, Bravo, at the last moment, opens the face to guide it past the diving keeper to the third-man boundary
angling in towards middle, pushed into the off side for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, tried to slash that square, missed
bowled a full toss outside off, that's driven well through extra cover, a couple more runs in the deep
dropped that towards cover, sent back after he called for a single, Dravid msses a run-out at the striker's end, didn't miss by much, had just one stump to aim at
shortish on the pads, tries to flick it away, strikes him high on the pads
run-out, Jadeja came down the track to drive that, missed, and they tried to sneak in a bye, Yagnik collected and under-armed a throw to the stumps at the striker's end to find Vijay short
slips that wide outside off, tries to slash that one hard past point, misses
nicely driven, full outside off and he crashed it wide of long-off, a couple of runs partly thanks to a wayward throw to the non-striker's end
Vijay reaches his second fifty this season with a neat flick past short fine to the boundary, on middle and leg, clips it away elegantly
slower one outside off, Vijay tries to slap that through cover, mistimes it back to the bowler
slower one, comes down the track to launch it over long-on, miscues it for a single towards point
yorker length on middle, digs that one out past the bowler for a single to long-on
slower one, Vijay tries to whack it over the bowler's head, misses
bowled a yorker on middle, digs it out towards cover for a single
yorker length outside off, fails to dig that one out
the back-of-the-hand slower ball, runs that one down to third man for a single
full toss on the off, crunched towards long-on for a single
missed run-out, inside edge onto the pads, Vijay wants the single, Jadeja sends him back, Faulkner picks it up and misses an under-arm throw to the striker's end, should have got him out there
rocks forward does Vijay and pushes that towards long-on for a well-run couple
angling in towards off and middle, defended towards point for a quick single
slower one bowled slightly short on the off, defended towards point
short and Vijay pulls but not well enough, just the couple over midwicket, long-on runs to his right and cuts it off
short of a good length, gets forward, takes his bottom hand off that one as he tries to play it into the leg side
short of a length outside off, cut down towards third man for a single
Jadeja times it well but Cooper dives to his left at mid-off to keep them to just two, driven well by Jadeja
dropped that one short on middle, ducks under that one
on a good length, drives it down to long-on for a single
gets across to that straight delivery and flicks it over midwicket for a couple of runs, nicely timed
that one is bowled down the leg side, tries to flick that one fine, misses
slightly short on the off, runs that one down to third man for a single
ooh, moves away after pitching, he makes room to smack that over extra cover, misses
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and taps it towards point
on a good length, gets forward and shows him the full face as he plays it back to the bowler

Dhoni goes! Cooper has struck again, lands on a length, Dravid had kept a slip, Dhoni tried to strike that hard through the line, gets a thick edge and Watson makes no mistake at first slip, huge wicket
short of a good length and he lets this one through to the keeper
on a length and he goes after it immediately, tries to smash it straight but ends up slicing it over point for a couple of runs, lands safe
bowled on a good length, drives it down to long-on for a single
Raina goes, what was he doing? Long-off was near the ropes and he just drove it uppishly towards him, didn't time it as well, comfortable catch
struck it uppishly past extra cover, wide of long-off, for a couple of runs
tries to drive it through cover, it moves away to just go past the outside edge, a loose drive
bowled it full on leg stump, drives it back past the bowler
bowled'im! On leg stump and Hussey tried to smash it over square leg, went for the pull, missed and leg stump was knocked out
tries to flick it away through the leg side, they try to steal a leg-bye, Hussey is sent back, Binny's attempt to kick it back onto the stumps misses its mark
tapped towards point and tries to steal a single, Rahane collects and throws at the striker's end, misses, Hussey would have been gone had that hit
Hussey seemed to lose it for a bit, missed the pull and it struck him high on the pads, Hussey looked up thinking it may have lobbed up off his pads but it didn't
shortish outside off, makes a bit of room and slaps it towards deep cover for a single
shortish on middle and leg, clipped away through square leg for a single
kept low, slightly short outside off, tries to pull it past midwicket but it didn't rise up as much as he expected
cut away, slightly short outside off and that's struck past point, Binny from third man runs across to his left and dives but makes a mess of it, ends up kicking it away to the ropes
wide, Hussey had to reach out to play a drive there, didn't make contact, called a wide
slightly short outside off, drags it towards midwicket, can't quite beat him
gets on the back foot and runs that behind point for a single
on a good length, gets forward and taps it towards point and races through for a single
slightly short, chops that one down towards point
slightly short, tries to turn it fine, clips high on the pads
shortish on middle, worked away through square leg into the deep for a single
poor start by Binny who bowls round the wicket, down the leg side, a full toss to top that and Hussey glances it down to the fine-leg boundary
pitches it up, drives it towards long-off for a single
pitches on a length on middle and that's been driven towards long-on for a single
turned away through square leg into the deep for a couple of runs
slightly short outside off, chops that one down to third man for a single
knocks it away to get a single
short of a good length, runs that down to third man for a single

Just wide of Rahane at point, was it dropped? short outside off and he cuts it away uppishly, Rahane dives low to his left to stop it, didn't get his fingers under the ball in time, missed it totally, that was a chance
takes it from outside off and works it wristily through midwicket for a couple of runs, the fielder in the deep takes a while to get to it
smartly done by Vijay, short of a good length, it nips away and he opens the face to run it down to the third-man boundary
lands on a good length, eases it through the covers into the deep for a single
short and he seized the length early, rocks back and pulls it hard through midwicket
beaten as it nipped away off a good length from the off stump
shortish outside off, cracked towards deep point for a single
dropped short and that's been pulled away hard, struck sweetly past midwicket and he found the gap
shortish on the off and that's slapped towards mid-on
tapped away and steals a single
was in the air for a while, on a good length and that was sliced past point into the deep for a single
stands tall and pushes that one towards mid-on from the crease
slides that one down the leg side and it's called a wide
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and guides it past point for a couple of runs
width from Watson and Vijay drives a little loosely at that one
shortish on the off, stands tall, gets on the back foot and punches it through extra cover, poor fielding, misfield there and it went through his legs, Faulkner was the man
ooh, drives him uppishly, on a good length and he drives that over extra cover, didn't time it all that well, landed safely though and cleared the in-field
short of a good length on the off, gets back and defends it into the off side
the slower one, that cut away, a left-arm wrist-spin action on that one, Hussey played inside the line and was beaten
superbly struck, short of a length and that was a lovely sound of bat hitting ball, cracked away through point for a boundary
slightly short outside off, slaps that one towards point but cannot beat the fielder, Rahane is the man
bowled it full, pushes that solidly towards mid-on, no run on offer there
bowled on a good length, he sees that through to the keeper
bowled it full on middle, that's driven wide of mid-on, no run on offer
on a good length, that's been driven back to the bowler firmly
on a good length, gets on the back foot and taps it away into the off side
poor ball, full down the leg side, Hussey should have dispatched that fine, clipped the pads and they get two leg-byes
slightly short outside off, leaves that one to the keeper

slightly short on the off, punched off the back foot through point into the deep, nicely timed again, good teamwork in the deep, two fielders gave chase, Binny flipped the ball back to Rahane who helped save a run
short of a good length outside off, moves away and that's been left alone
lucky is Hussey, Malik's not, on a good length and Hussey tries to drive it through cover, gets an inside edge just past the stumps to the fine-leg boundary
not giving much away here, Hussey stepped out of the track there but eventually just saw it through to the keeper
bowled on a good length outside off, he leaves that one alone to the keeper
angling in towards middle, worked towards midwicket and he steals a single
shortish on the off, punches that one past mid-off, Cooper gave that chase and was struggling to catch up with it, nicely timed, he dives, reaches but palms it over the ropes
pitched up on the off stump and that's been driven through the line to the bowler
tries to turn the face on that one, strikes him high on the pads as he gets on the back foot
shortish on the off and that's been knocked away into the off side
shortish outside off and that's cut down towards third man for a single
on a good length, rocks on the front foot and pushes that back towards the bowler
on a good length, gets front and across and pushes that back to the bowler
slightly short on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it into the leg side
bowled it full on middle and that's been driven back to the bowler, good start by Malik
in the channel outside off, this one goes away and Vijay lets it go
bowled on a good length, pushes that one wide of mid-off for a quick single
appeal for lbw, this one nipped back in from the off stump, struck high on the pads as he tried to leave that one alone, was too high
bowled that one in the channel outside off and he shoulders arms to the keeper
slides on the pads, tries to work that square, clips the pads on the way to fine leg for a single
Binny finishes it off in style, comes down the track and lofts that beautifully over the extra cover boundary
bowled on a good length, drives it towards long-off, no run on offer there
yorker, a superb yorker that gets rid of him, Watson tries to drive him through the on side, Watson  misses and the leg stump is knocked back
Watson keeps finding the boundary, short of a length, flies off the outside edge as he tries to slap it back past the bowler
makes a bit of room and plays that towards third man for a single
on a good length, Binny tries to drive through off, just goes past the outside edge
slightly short outside off, cut away towards deep point for a single
shortish on the off, slapped towards long-off for a single
shortish outside off, that's cut away towards point
tickles it into the leg side for a single
slightly short, punched off the back foot to the left of midwicket
floating it on middle, driven towards midwicket
oh dear, four more, down the leg side and he tries to clip it fine, if his bat didn't connect, the pads did the work for him, oh the umpire has actually given it runs, there you are
edged and four, length ball and he tries to smash that down the ground, gets a thick edge past Dhoni to the boundary
he keeps finding the boundary, low full toss on middle and he flicks it away into that big gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg, Ashwin dives, can't get to it
back of a length outside off, nips back in and he chops it, too close to his body there, towards the keeper
that's poorly bowled, slow ball down the leg side and Watson helps it on its way to the fine-leg boundary, applause for Watson all around, a half-century
shortish outside off, tries to open the face to play it to third man, misses
bowled it full on middle, driven towards wide long-on for a single this time
six more, he's cleared Jadeja again, lands on a length and he smashes that through the line over long-on, though it wasn't well middled, it still was struck well enough to get it over long-on
Rajasthan have surged ahead here, short outside off and Watson has picked the length early, thrashes it over deep midwicket, 35 off 38 sounds easy now, what a partnership
short and that's pulled to deep square leg this time for a single
back of a length, gets back and pulls it through square leg for a couple of runs, Mohit runs to his left and dives to save that
what a superb counterattack this is, comes down the track while making a bit of room simultaneously, launches Bravo high and handsome over extra cover
that is supremely hit, confidence personified, Holder bowls this one on a good length and Watson reaches forward and smacks him hard and flat over the long-off boundary, through the line
uppishly played but in the gap, shortish outside off, cut towards third man for a single
shortish outside off, guides that down to third man for one more
back of a length on the off, defended towards cover and runs through for a single
back of a length on the off, knocks it down towards point and he steals a single
angling in towards middle and off, defended towards point from the crease
on the pads and it's dealt with comfortably, glanced down to the fine-leg boundary, poor ball
bowled it full on the off, driven towards mid-off, no chance of a single this time

well struck, short and wide and that's fiercely hit, slashed away over point, width and he cashed in, the right amount of bounce as well, Hussey dived with his orange cap at third man but it was too quick for him
on a good length, knocks that one down in front of point for a quick single
on a good length, pushed it towards mid-off for a quick single, Holder throws and concedes one more
shortish outside off, tries to run it down towards third man, misses
could this be the turning point in this game? Gave it some air and Watson was going after it, landed on middle and Watson absolutely hammered that towards cow corner
that's well struck, what a welcome for Ashwin, tossed up on the off and that's slog-swept comfortably over deep midwicket
played towards midwicket, Raina collects and throws down stumps at the non-striker's end but he has dived and slid his bat comfortably in
Just over Ravindra Jadeja, flat but he seemed to have made his mind up, slog-swept that hard and got it just over Jadeja, who dived to his right, for a six
slightly short on the off, punches it off the back foot past deep extra cover for a couple of runs
short and down the leg side, called a wide
bowled it flat outside off,  slams it hard but along the ground to deep midwicket
bowled it full on middle, clips it through square leg into the deep for a single
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot and drops it down towards cover for a single
bowled it on a length outside off, gets an outside edge towards third man as he tries to drive
slightly short on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it down towards the bowler
Rajasthan in further trouble, short of a length, Dravid tried to cut that over point, got a thick edge to Dhoni, good bounce again, four down now
Makes a bit of room to punch it through the off side, gets an inside edge past the keeper for a couple of runs, Dhoni has to give chase
slightly short outside off and that's been chopped towards slip
Watson goes big, nicely struck, on a good length from Bravo and Watson just launched it over the long-on boundary
back of a length on the off, punches it towards deep cover for a single
short of a good length outside off, tries to cut it away, misses
on a good length, gets forward and drives it towards deep midwicket for a single
slightly short on the off, chops that one into the off side
beaten, on a good length and he fishes for that one outside off, misses
gets on the back foot and knocks it down towards point
shortish on the off, drags it between long-on and deep midwicket for a couple of runs
ohh, that must have hurt, went for a pull, got an inside edge and got struck on the stomach, was painful
short of a length on middle, pulled towards deep square leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, runs that one down to third man for a single
ooh, short of a good length, came back in, got an inside edge onto the pads
ooh, there is a widish first slip in place, guides that one to the third-man boundary, opens the face there and gets it wide of a diving first slip to beat third man
slightly short on the off, punches it towards extra cover for a single
gets forward and taps it in front of cover for a single
slightly short on the off, tries to punch it through extra cover, gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single
on a good length, reaches forward and drives it towards extra cover
beaten, short of a good length and that zips past the outside edge, Chennai's powerplay this

bowled it full outside off, drives it towards point, Bravo dives full length to his right, and tries to throw down the stumps at the striker's end, Dravid makes it back, slips, and then steals an overthrow
beaten this time, good bounce, short of a good length and he tried to defend, went past the outside edge
on a good length and it nipped back in, Dravid tried to defend that, played inside the line, got a thick edge between the slips
angling in towards middle, pushes that one back towards the bowler

Jadeja scores a direct hit, he's a superb fielder, shortish outside off, chops it towards point, Jadeja collects it with his left hand and throws down the stumps at the striker's end, but Watson was well in
ooh, Watson goes after it first up, that landed on a good length and moved away, Watson reached forward to drive that hard, missed

edged and gone, three down! Short of a length outside off, nipped back in this time, Samson tried to chop it into the off side, got an under edge and Dhoni moved well to his left to snap that one, Chennai have taken three early
shortish outside off, keeps a little low and he misses as he tries to reach it
on a good length, tries to slash that past point, it moves away and he misses it
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and turns it past midwicket for a single
short of a length outside off, makes room to slash that, misses
angling in towards middle, gets across and drives it towards mid-on
off stump has been knocked out of the ground, on a good length, makes room to try to smash that over extra cover, misses and the stump takes a beating
shortish on the off, punched off the back foot through the covers for three runs, nicely struck
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks that one down in front of square leg for a single
ooh, good low catch, Vijay ran in from mid-on and took it well bending low, Rahane came down the track and tried to clear mid-on but mistimed it straight to Vijay
ooh, beats the gap between point and cover, shortish outside off and he chops it well through those two fielders for a boundary
slightly short outside off, Dravid moves away to punch that through extra cover, gets a thick inside edge back to the bowler
dropped it short and Rahane pulls, gets it high on the bat and it lands safe, three runs behind square leg
short of a good length, gets back and defends it towards cover from the crease
short of a good length outside off, tries to crash that through point, misses
Rahane swings and is lucky to get a boundary there, tried to swing it away over midwicket, got an inside edge to the fine-leg boundary
back of a length outside off, nips away and he leaves this one alone to the keeper
good bounce, short of a good length and that took off, got on the back foot to chop it into the off side, just went past the outside edge
shortish on middle, rocks back and fends it into the leg side for a single
on a good length, rocks forward and defends it well towards extra cover
and again, drew Rahane forward who tried to defend on the off side, nipped away to go past the outside edge
beaten first up, on a good length and nips away to beat the outside edge as he tries to play off the back foot
on a good length and Dravid knocks that into the ground towards point
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and defends it solidly back towards the bowler
shortish on the off, gets on the back foot to defend in the off side, gets an inside edge onto the pads
short of a length outside off, chops that one into the off side towards point
slightly short, rocks back and defends it towards point from the crease
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and punches it into the off side
